hotels.title: Fiji Mana Island Adults-Only Beachfront Villas with All-Inclusive Dining & Unlimited Free-Flow Drinks
hotels.description: Experience all-inclusive indulgence in a haven that’s open to only 10 guests amid Fiji’s world-famous Mamanuca Islands. This ultra-luxurious resort is surrounded by four secluded beaches on Mana Island, yet a cocktail is ready to toast your escape at a moment’s notice. Delivering impeccable luxury in a breathtaking tropical landscape, this romantic adults-only retreat offers untouched beaches and preserved reefs. Sink into a Fijian fantasy with a couples’ massage, then recline in your private villa just steps from dazzling blue waters. Gaze at the glistening South Pacific Ocean from your private pool, kayak through the kaleidoscopic coral reef, melt away with treatments at the Wai Siliva Alfresco Spa and enjoy once-in-a-lifetime gourmet experiences such as a private dinner under the stars. In an ocean of world-class islands, this decadent hideaway offers superlative service and a sense of serenity that must be experienced to be believed.
